name: load-custom-key
description: A load whose model-name key is the operator-declared activation_model_key: the body carries that key, not model_name.

provenance.reference: TabbyAPI model management routes POST /v1/model/load (streamed JSON lines), POST /v1/model/unload, GET /v1/model; the gateway's http-load-unload lifecycle driver reads them (gateway/lifecycle_drivers.py)
